div.div: Per tailed file TailFileState: Tailing | Rotated | Truncated | Deleted | Whole | Error. Identity (inode or file index) detects rotation; deletedFiles keep | drop; the last event of a text file is written after carry_flush_ms (500 ms) or when another follows; events are on disk, so nothing is evicted.

div.div: Alerts and per-file tail status are computed by imt_core::live::LiveSession over the store ports (ADR 0037). Profile [live]: alerts = error_spike, silence, crash, slow_outlier, rate_change, memory_growth; silence_after 60s, cooldown 5m, window 5m, clock data | wall; [[live.rule]] {name, when (QL), threshold, window, severity}. Detectors run when records were inserted, at most every detectEveryMs (1 s); rules and silences on every batch.
